'''Thomas McGee''' (also published as '''Tom McGee''') is a Colorado Star Wars CCG player. He played at [[December 2001 Greeley tournament]] on 1 December 2001 with YMSYL Garrison drains, according to David Jones's tournament report,<ref name="tr-d3144">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-12-04-greeley-co-12-1-revised-long-timed3144/ greeley-co-12-1-revised-long-time], DeckTech (David "DavCJ" Jones, 4 December 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-12-04-greeley-co-12-1-revised-long-timed3144/ GitHub Pages].</ref> finished 3rd at [[February 2002 Parker tournament]],<ref name="tr-d3338">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2002-02-06-the-downfall-of-swccg-parker-cod3338/ the-downfall-of-swccg-parker-co], DeckTech (Tom "Divebum101" Meade, 6 February 2002). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2002-02-06-the-downfall-of-swccg-parker-cod3338/ GitHub Pages].</ref> and finished Top 4 at [[2002 Houston DPC]] on 14 July 2002 with WYS Raiders, according to Jacob Taylor's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3841">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2002-07-16-houston-texas-07-14-02-dpc-houstond3841/ houston-texas-07-14-02-dpc-houston], DeckTech (Jacob "Armaedes" Taylor, 16 July 2002). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2002-07-16-houston-texas-07-14-02-dpc-houstond3841/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
